message_title: Minor bugs identified in live motion and process animation modules
message_msg:
The shortcut keys does not works when the app is on background
I am fixing that as soon as possible, also on the process animation section
when I override a status manually it omits all the subsequent statuses,
that is not the intended flow so I am correcting that, both fixes will be completed on next update, stay tunned
update_msg:
- Changes are now saved persistently
- Process animation section implemented: 
  You can now upload your audio and the character automatically applies the animations
  Currently supports .wav and .ogg formats but works better with .ogg
  Stay tunned on next updates for this section to be improved
